name: S0
description: Incident: main red, deploy broken, data or security risk

name: S1
description: Incident: same failure signature on 2+ PRs

name: S2
description: Incident: failure on one PR only

name: incident
description: Incident issue (opened by CI or an agent)

name: confirmed
description: Bug reproduced by a different agent or shown by a failing test

name: needs-review
description: PR ready for an independent review

name: changes-requested
description: Review failed; see the exact required changes

name: blocked
description: Blocked on something outside the PR

name: escalate
description: 3+ No-progress comments from 2+ agents: priority run decides

name: quarantined
description: Perf check with <95% pass rate on unchanged main

name: lease-expired
description: Lease passed and no commits for 3 hours; may be taken over
